For example, fans would spam 3 when he plays badly, and spam 9 when he plays especially well. ** Therefore, nicknamed "The Dice Man." * As of Spring 2024, he is known to have never missed Playoffs since he started playing in the LPL. * Considered to be the best {{ci|Vladimir}} in China. === Statistics === * Reached 1000 kills in the LPL on February 02, 2023. ** The 36th player and 3rd toplaner (after [[Flandre]] and [[TheShy]]) to reach 1000 kills in the LPL. * Reached 1500 kills in the LPL on January 18, 2025. ** The 25th player and 2nd toplaner after [[Flandre]] to reach 1500 kills in the LPL. * Reached 300 wins in the LPL on August 05, 2023. ** Was the 19th player to reach 300 wins in the LPL. * Reached 400 wins in the LPL on March 29, 2025. ** Was the 11th player to reach 400 wins in the LPL. * Reached 500 games in the LPL on June 23, 2024 ** The 24th player to reach 500 games in the LPL. * Reached 600 games in the LPL on May 3, 2025 ** The 16th player to reach 600 games in the LPL. * Reached 3000 assists in the LPL on June 26, 2024. ** Was the 31st player to reach 3000 assists in the LPL. * Reached 4000 assists in the LPL on August 26, 2025. ** The 22nd player to reach 4000 assists in the LPL. === Individual Awards === * LPL 1st All-Pro Team x3 (Summer 2022, Spring 2023, Split 2 2025) * LPL 2nd All-Pro Team x4 (Spring 2019, Summer 2023, Spring 2024, Split 3 2025) * LPL 3rd All-Pro Team x4 (Spring 2020, Summer 2020, Spring 2021.
